scope: MS2 technical verification, not clinical validation

live_cli.question: Which clinical trials may suit this patient? Explain supporting evidence, screening barriers, and concerns requiring review.

http_api: FastAPI TestClient /health, /patients, /screen; offline responses and invalid requests checked
manual_source_checks: Latest usable HbA1c 3.6% on 2021-08-13 matches source LOINC 4548-4, not a synthesized value.
NCT04874012 age over 30 and HbA1c 7.5%-10.5% compared to exact source criteria.
Every returned criterion present exactly once and evidence IDs resolve to the selected synthetic patient.
Unverified negative evidence, medication requests alone, complex thresholds/time logic are downgraded to UNKNOWN; model_decision preserves the proposed decision for audit.
limitations: Most conditions in the checked live example remain UNKNOWN; no clinical accuracy claim.
No real patients, calibration, full 25 x 1313 evaluation, production security or deployed frontend.
Mixed patient/registry reference dates are retained and labeled.
Cohort detection and evidence guards are conservative heuristics; human review remains required.

english_cli_revision.note: The successful live replay reused real English GCP model responses from cache. Grouped valid citations are now accepted and each identifier is checked.
